description:
List files and directories (depth 1-3, limit up to 200). include_ignored=true also lists ignored folders.
Use when: you need the directory tree or want to confirm a path exists.
Avoid when: you know the file (read_file) or want what changed lately (recent_files).
Output: entries[] {relative_path, kind, size_bytes}, truncated.

include_ignored.description: true also lists ignored folders (default false).

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative ('.' = root); absolute/.. outside it rejected.
